context: Tests whether the agent writes Playwright e2e tests for the Product Catalog page (UC-010) following the playwright-test skill: test.describe named after the use case, tests tagged with the UC id, native accessibility-first Playwright locators (no CSS/XPath selectors), no waitForTimeout/Thread.sleep-style waits, and blackbox tests that don't reference implementation code.

checklist.name: test.describe named after the use case
checklist.description: Tests are grouped in a test.describe block titled to include "UC-010" and the use case name (e.g. "UC-010: Browse Product Catalog")

checklist.name: Tests tagged with the use case id
checklist.description: Test cases use Playwright's tag option (e.g. { tag: "@UC-010" }) rather than only encoding the UC id in free text

checklist.name: Main scenario test present
checklist.description: A test covers the main success scenario: navigating to /products and verifying in-stock products are displayed in the table

checklist.name: A1 category filter test present
checklist.description: A test covers selecting the "Electronics" category and verifying the table only shows matching products

checklist.name: A2 empty-state test present
checklist.description: A test covers selecting the "Clearance" category and verifying the empty-state alert appears instead of the table

checklist.name: Accessible locators only
checklist.description: Element lookups use page.getByRole/getByLabel/getByText exclusively — no CSS selectors (page.locator with a class/tag selector) or XPath

checklist.name: No manual waits
checklist.description: The test file does not use page.waitForTimeout() or any fixed-delay sleep; assertions rely on Playwright's auto-retrying expect(locator)

checklist.name: Auto-retrying assertions
checklist.description: Assertions use expect(locator).toBeVisible()/toHaveText()/toHaveCount() style matchers rather than reading a boolean and asserting on it directly

checklist.name: Blackbox — no implementation references
checklist.description: The test file does not import or reference backend/frontend implementation classes, component internals, or file paths — only the rendered page

checklist.name: File placed under frontend/tests/e2e/
checklist.description: The test file is created under frontend/tests/e2e/
